editorial: **April to June:** We visited in early June. Athens was pleasant, while Santorini was heating up in both celsius and crowds. Spring (April to June) is not the most popular time to visit, which is exactly why we recommend it!

**September and October:** Warm seas and thinning crowds make early autumn a good time to visit as well. A word of caution however… Hospitality workers may be exhausted from the summer rush, so the quality of service may ever so slightly deteriorate.
**July and August:** Do not visit in July and August unless you really want to party, in which case having half of Europe on a tiny island may seem like a good predicament.
**November to March: **Winter is low season, which means a lot of businesses in the Aegean islands shut shop. Athens alone is not enough of a draw to visit Greece, so we’d avoid this time.
